n+1Click.title: N+1 Click 2024
n+1Click.highlight: This was the first attemp of the Photography Team of ASTO-Epikoinonoume to create a festival of such a scale. It hosted 12 exhibitions and 5 seminars/presentations. It lasted from the 29th of November until the 8th of December 2024.
